answer: Each identity must plant a juniper, a slow tree whose roots take seasons. Honest junipers grow in different shapes; a farm's are identical saplings. Every deed leaves a light in the nebula of past actions. Honest identities shine in many colors; a farm's cluster in one bright spot, all glowing the same. Trust is a pearl, grown layer by layer around a grain of real work. A farm's pearls are plastic beads, same outside, no layers inside. To pass, a farm must grow a real juniper, light a real nebula, and grow a real pearl for every sockpuppet.
